title: He Whakapaenga i raro i te Rangi Whakahohe
intro: Kei te tū koe i mua i tētahi ope taua whakamataku e whakatata atu ana ki tētahi wāhi tapu, me ngā patu katoa kua rite, ā, e tino mōhiotia ana te wikitoria. I mua i te tīmatanga o te whakaeke, ka puta mai tētahi mana ohorere i runga ake i a koe, ā, ka tīmata te whakataetae ki tētahi mea kāore i kitea i mua e tetahi.
clues: I hikoi mātou me te māia kāore e taea e tetahi mana o te ao te whakangaueue.
I mauria mai e mātou he arewhana nunui, ā, te āhua nei i hangaia tō mātou ope hei karapoti i a rātou.
I haere mai mātou ki te whakahoro i tētahi wāhi tapu e whakahonoretia ana, i te whakapono kua tino pono tō mātou wikitoria.
I tō mātou taenga atu, ka rere mai tētahi kahui hipi i te rangi i runga ake i a mātou.
I whiua e ngā manu ngā kōhatu uku mārō ki ō tātou toa.
I tino hinga mātou, pakaru ana, marara ana tō mātou ope nui, pērā i te pungarehu.
